key_structural_decisions.charge_deferred_to_he10_not_he09: HE09 NL 27,817 MW (MODERATE-SEVERE); hub DA ~$4/MWh; MCC ~-$3/MWh; GKS node ~$1/MWh. Charging at HE09 ($1 effective) vs holding NS and charging at HE10 (-$22 effective): Option B (HE10-12 only) earns $2,728 charge revenue vs Option A (HE09-12): $1,712. Difference $1,016 in favor of deferring charge to HE10. Battery has sufficient capacity to charge full SoC in HE10-12 window alone. Reject HE09 pre-charge. key_structural_decisions.extreme_duck_floor_primary: HE10-11 EXTREME dual-hour (NL 19,981/21,375 MW) — FIRST two-consecutive-hour EXTREME in Phase 2 series. This event is economically analogous to discharging at high prices — except on the charge side. Do not miss this window.

comparison_to_08_10_plan.driver: Duck floor inversion: 08/10 charge cost = -$2,314 (paid to charge); 08/11 charge revenue = +$4,100 (earned from charging). Swing = $6,414. Partially offset by -$375 lower discharge revenue (dome collapse moderates evening spike).

expected_revenue.empirical_realization_factor: Historical 08/01-04 confirmed realized = plan P50 x 0.65-0.80. However: 08/11 negative-price duck floor is structurally novel — the charge revenue is based on clearing at negative DA (which clears automatically if DA price is negative and BESS is bidding to charge). Realization risk concentrated on (1) discharge execution (Smartbidder partial dispatch) and (2) duck floor DA price being less negative than base case. Revised factor: 0.75-0.90 given clearer charge revenue mechanics at negative prices. Empirical realized estimate: $9,825-$11,793.

da_rt_spread_strategy.charge_window: DA vs RT: DA lock preferred for HE10-12. At negative DA prices, DA charge earns guaranteed revenue. RT at HE10 could be even more negative if real-time VRE overshoots — upside not captured in DA, but DA clears with certainty. Do not reject DA charge to chase RT upside at the duck floor.
da_rt_spread_strategy.discharge_window: DA lock preferred for HE20-21. 08/08 actuals: HE20 DA $34.59 > RT $23.79 (+$10.80); HE21 DA $36.82 > RT $30.54 (+$6.28). Monday/Tuesday WDPEAK historically DA-dominant. Risk: HE20 solar cliff (-13,469 MW) could cause thermal under-commitment -> RT spike above DA. Monitor HE20 DA clearing commitment. If DA HE20 looks thin (ERCOT advisory on fast-ramp commitment), shift to RT position via Stack B.
da_rt_spread_strategy.rrs_ecrs_da_vs_rt: ECRS: DA preferred (SOUTH_HOUSTON MH 35-50% drives DA AS prices). RRS: not offered (not clearing historically; 5+ cycle pattern).
da_rt_spread_strategy.spread_convention: spread = DA - RT. Positive = DA more expensive = short DA / long RT signal. Currently: no P(DA>RT) quantitative signal (Smartbidder DEGRADED). Qualitative: DA > RT for discharge (confirmed 08/08 pattern + Tuesday WDPEAK commercial structure).
